items.summary: CFO recommendation: maintain financial containment and retain only existing reconciliation, repair-or-close, measurement, and evidence work. Supported revenue is limited to 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI spend is $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with prior records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned; hosting, domains, labor, marketing, experiment, and other operating costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Minimum measurement is one reconciled period-aligned ledger, a resolved AI-cost record, site/content-level commission attribution, and isolated outcome-versus-cost measurement. Reject discretionary spend, commitments, forecasts, monetization expansion, requeues, and unsupported revenue claims. Treat clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, ordered items, and technical performance as operating signals—not financial return—until attributable revenue and costs are evidenced.

Handoff: continue the existing finance reconciliation only. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed, resolve conflicting AI-cost records, and assemble the missing period-aligned cost ledger before any margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, forecast, or spend decision.
